_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Sampeyan yaiku Player {player_id} ing game Liar's Dice {num_players}-pemain.
Rules:
- Nalika giliran sampeyan, sampeyan bisa:
  1) Nawangi bidh anyar kanthi kuantitas utawa face kang luwih dhuwur (utawa kaloro) tinimbang bidh kang saiki; yaiku '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Ngandika bidh pungkasan kanthi ngetik '[Call]'.

Yen sampeyan ngandika:
  - Yen cathetan asli saka face value kang padha karo kabeh dadu kurang saka bid, pembidik pungkasan ilang siji dadu.
  - Yen ora, pangandik ilang siji dadu.
Pemain kang mencapai 0 dadu kaeliminasi. Pemain kang pungkasan kang kari menang.

board.new_round:
Babak anyar - Dadu kang kari: {dice_summary}
Dadu sampeyan saiki: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} ngandika! Cathetan asli saka face {face_value} yaiku {count}, kang kurang saka {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (pembidik pungkasan) ilang siji dadu.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} ngandika! Cathetan asli saka face {face_value} yaiku {count}, kang >= {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (pangandik) ilang siji dadu.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Aksi ora diakoni minangka '[Bid: X, Y]' utawa '[Call]' kang sah. Aksi kang dikirim: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Jumlah anyar {new_quantity} luwih murah tinimbang saiki {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nilai nominal anyar {new_face_value} luwih murah tinimbang saiki {current_face_value} .

message.eliminated_invalid: Pemain {player_id} dibuwang kanthi pamindhahan sing ora valid.
